citation: Higgins JPT, Morgan RL, Rooney AA, et al. A tool to assess risk of bias in non-randomized follow-up studies of exposure effects (ROBINS-E). Environ Int. 2024;186:108602. Tool version of 24 March 2024 (riskofbias.info), CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.
source_notes: Domain 1, variant (a): the flowchart branch from 1.3 after WN to 1.1 is labelled N/PN; NI is read as N/PN, as in the branch after Y/PY to 1.1.

Domain 2: questions 2.3 and 2.4 are officially asked 'If SY/WY to 2.2' and 'If SY/WY to 2.2 and N/PN/WY to 2.3'; the flowchart also sends NI through the same box, so NI is included in both conditions.
Overall: several domains at high risk may justify a very high overall judgement (official guidance); the system suggests the worst domain and warns, the reviewer decides.
